subject: general
question: Which of the following states emerged as a champion state under the Van Dhan Vikas Yojana in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Manipur emerged as a champion state under the Van Dhan Vikas Yojana in 2021 due to its effective implementation of the scheme.
 
• The state set up numerous Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) to empower tribal communities by promoting value addition to forest products.
 
• Manipur's success was driven by its focus on capacity building, skill development, and market linkages for tribal entrepreneurs.
 
• The state has a significant tribal population that benefited from the initiatives aimed at improving their socio-economic status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Van Dhan Vikas Yojana**

 
 
• It is an initiative of the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and TRIFED (Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India).
 
• The scheme aims to improve the livelihood of tribal communities by establishing VDVKs for value addition, branding, and marketing of Minor Forest Produce (MFP).
 
• Tribal communities are encouraged to collect, process, and sell forest products to enhance their income.
 
• The scheme also focuses on skill upgradation and capacity building among tribal members to create sustainable livelihoods.
 
 
 
• **Minor Forest Produce (MFP)**
 
 
• MFP includes all non-timber forest products such as bamboo, tamarind, honey, and medicinal plants.
 
• These products are crucial for the subsistence and economy of tribal communities.
 
• The collection and sale of MFPs provide significant income to tribal families, especially in forest-rich regions.
 
 
 
• **Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India (TRIFED)**
 
 
• TRIFED was established in 1987 under the Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 1984.
 
• Its primary objective is to promote the socio-economic development of tribal communities through marketing development activities.
 
• TRIFED assists in the creation of market linkages for tribal products, ensuring fair trade and better income for tribal producers.
